constraints: Netlify CLI is installed via npx; no global install is required.
Authentication requires a Netlify account with an active login session.
The project must be a valid web project in the current directory.
When sandboxing blocks deployment network calls, rerun the deployment with sandbox_permissions=require_escalated.
Deployment might take a few minutes; use appropriate timeout values.
Never commit secrets to Git.
Set secrets in the Netlify dashboard under Site Settings → Environment Variables.
Access secrets in builds via process.env.VARIABLE_NAME.
If browser authentication isn't available, users can set the NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable.
Tokens can be generated at https://app.netlify.com/user/applications#personal-access-tokens.
